text:
Cam (People Ops): Heads-up  Rosa Hernandez starts Tue. Shes traveling in Monday evening and asked if we can do a late I-9 (6pm) and deliver the laptop to her hotel (St. Francis). Shes got an Employment Authorization Document (EAD) + CA driver license. Q: EAD covers List A, right?

Lina (Onboarding): EAD is List A, yes  it clears the I-9. We can do 6pm in-person or NotaryNow fallback. Note: remote notary requires candidate to be physically in the US during session. Please ask Rosa to upload front/back of EAD to secure portal by EOD Mon.

Rosa (candidate): I can do 6pm at HQ or meet the notary after check-in. Hotel pickup is fine but prefer front desk hold. Also need Spanish interpreter for the first-hour orientation, please.

Diego (Hiring Manager): I can stay late to greet and do a quick team intro. Spanish interpreter requested, added. Also quick question: when will benefits enrollment link be sent? Rosa wants to review health plan before first payday.

Benefits-bot: Auto: New hires get 30 days post-start to enroll. We will send the benefits enrollment email on Day 1 AM with links and a benefits PDF. Contact benefits@redwood.com for broker questions.

IT-bot: We can ship to hotel with exact hold-for label and mobile. Asset will be held until AUP signed. Please ensure AUP link is signed before pick-up. Sample label: "Hold for: Rosa Hernandez / Redwood Inference - Guest Pickup" + hotel name + mobile. We can stage VPN profile after AUP + asset sign-off.

ClearCheck (BG vendor): Vendor note  EAD verified usually fast; without SSN some county checks may be limited. Candidate should sign consent ASAP; expect 24-48h for ID-based checks.

Lina (Onboarding): Action items: 1) Send secure upload link to Rosa now, 2) Book Spanish interpreter for 6pm I-9 slot and add NotaryNow fallback link in invite, 3) IT to queue hotel hold and email AUP, 4) Benefits-bot send Day 1 enrollment email.

Cam (People Ops): Done 603 I sent upload link and AUP. Rosa replied: "Uploading EAD now and will confirm 6pm HQ." IT  please use guest pickup label and include Rosa's mobile. Lina  confirm interpreter in calendar.

Lina (Onboarding): Interpreter confirmed, calendar invite sent with NotaryNow fallback and checklist: upload EAD, sign BG consent, sign AUP, review benefits packet. Closing thread once docs + AUP done. :thumbsup:
